### Core Concept & Philosophy

- **Name & Etymology:** In classical philosophy (Plato’s *Timaeus*), the **Khora** (χώρα) represents the formless, receptive matrix from which all forms, shapes, and material realities are synthesized. In modern artificial intelligence, it is the direct conceptual ancestor of the **latent space** — the continuous, multidimensional realm navigated by generative foundation models to synthesize new meaning, text, and form.
- **Organic Morphology:** The central mark is a **continuous sculptural Möbius trefoil knot** — an infinite topological 1-manifold with continuous $G^2$ curvature. It features three-fold rotational harmony representing the foundational triad of generative synthesis (**Prompt**, **Latent Representation**, and **Emergent Synthesis**).
- **Volumetric Lighting & Depth:** The curves feature continuous organic width modulation (swelling gracefully along the outer lobes and tapering at the crossings) combined with analytical **ambient occlusion contact shadows** and soft specular falloff, providing a tactile, sculpted stone and cast ceramic presence without rigid tech clichés.
